model.name: merge.nativeFoldByMethod
model.description: Code-folding uses Monaco NATIVE folding: standard chevron collapse/expand controls in the gutter + a '...' placeholder for a collapsed region (NOT setHiddenAreas hide-lines, which Tron REJECTED - broke mobile). Foldable regions are the METHOD boundaries (fold a whole method block). Architect derives the native FoldingController approach.
